description: This file defines a Flutter widget called ResidentCard, which displays information about a resident, including their name and unit, within a styled card layout. It also handles tap interactions.

classes.name: ResidentCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that presents resident information in a stylized card with tap handling.

methods.name: ResidentCard
methods.description: Constructor for the ResidentCard widget, accepting a Resident object and an optional onTap callback.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the resident card, displaying the resident's initial, name, and unit.
